about.title: About Squared Away Painting
text: When you need painting services in Houston, you deserve a team that shows up prepared, works with care, and delivers results that last. Squared Away Painting brings professionalism, reliability, and attention to detail to every residential and commercial project we take on.

Since 2019, we've been serving the Greater Houston area with a commitment to doing things right—from proper surface preparation to high-quality materials and lasting finishes. As a locally owned and operated, women-owned business, we understand what it means to earn your trust through honest work and clear communication.

We believe every painting project should be handled with respect for your property, your schedule, and your vision. That's why we keep our job sites clean, provide detailed proposals, and follow through on what we promise.
